title: Selected Poems - Jibananandan Das

vibeProfile.oneLine: Selected poems of the great Bengali modernist Jibanananda Das.

summary: A selection of the poetry of Jibanananda Das, widely regarded as the most important Bengali poet after Tagore and a pioneer of modernism in the language. Steeped in the landscapes, rivers and twilight of rural Bengal, his verse is haunting, image-rich and suffused with beauty, loss and a deep sense of time. His famous poem 'Banalata Sen' is among the best-loved in Bengali. This collection introduces a singular, dreamlike poetic voice.
whyReadIt: The haunting, image-rich poetry of Jibanananda Das, the great Bengali modernist after Tagore. Dreamlike and beautiful.

funFacts.text: His poem 'Banalata Sen' is one of the most famous and beloved in all of Bengali poetry.
